text: Harbour City ने मैच के पहले हाफ में अच्छा प्रदर्शन करते हुए Elias Okafor के गोल से 1-0 की बढ़त बनाई, इसके बाद Marek Barros ने भी गोल किया और टीम को 2-0 से आगे कर दिया [#905] [#975]। हालांकि, Seabrook Town ने जल्दी हार नहीं मानी और Tariq Marlowe, Callum Varga, और Kian Romano के साथ बाद के गोलों से मैच को पलट दिया [#1104] [#1448] [#1882] [#1906]। खास बात यह है कि Kian Romano ने मैच के आखिरी समय में दो गोल कर जीत दिलाई, जिनका xG 0.745 और 0.956 था, मतलब ये मौके आमतौर पर ज़्यादा गोल में बदलते हैं [#1882] [#1906]। Seabrook Town ने ज़्यादा शॉट्स मारे (22 बनाम 10) और गेंद पर भी ज़्यादा कब्ज़ा रखा (53.4%), जबकि Harbour City को 43वें मिनट में Joon Whitfield का रैड कार्ड मिला, जिसने उनकी ताकत को प्रभावित किया [#870] [#871]।

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in hi

- Seabrook Town won 4-2 despite trailing 2-0 early in the second half [#1104, #975].  
- Marek Barros scored with an xG of 0.185 and made 5 key passes plus 2 assists, earning player of the match [#975].  
- Kian Romano scored twice in stoppage time with xG 0.745 and 0.956 to clinch the comeback [#1882, #1906].  
- Seabrook Town had higher overall xG 3.87 vs 1.82 and more shots on target 9 vs 5 [team_stats].  
- Joon Whitfield was sent off for Harbour City at 43' when score was still 0-0 [#871].

- Seabrook Town's comeback and eventual victory reflect a pattern of regaining possession quickly and exploiting transitions, evident in goals at 53', 69', and two rapid strikes in added time from regained balls and quick passes [1103-1104,1447-1448,1881-1882,1905-1906].
- Their style of wide, crossing play (3-4-3 formation) is seen in the goals involving through balls and crosses, such as Marek Barros' goal from a corner cross for Harbour City and Seabrook’s use of wing players like Callum Varga and assists by Tariq Marlowe and Aiden Quinlan [973-975 (Harbour corner),1447-1448,1881-1882].
- Harbour City, playing 4-2-3-1 with a patient short-passing style, constructed an initial long build-up for their first goal involving 17 passes over almost a minute, showing their preference for controlled possession and buildup [904-905].
- Tactical shifts show Seabrook Town pressing higher and adopting more direct play after falling behind, increasing press intensity from 0.66 to 0.84 and directness from 0.42 to 0.57, leading to more regains and quick attacks facilitating their scoring runs [1361].
- Conversely, Harbour City's late change to press higher and play more direct (press 0.6 to 0.78, directness 0.28 to 0.43) was a reactive attempt to chase the game but coincided with conceding and losing control, reflecting difficulties in imposing their initial style under pressure [1884].
- The red card to Joon Whitfield at 43’ impacted the early phase, likely forcing Harbour City to adjust defensively before their goals, while Seabrook used their numerical advantage to control possession and field tilt into the second half [870-871].
